description: Routes a plain-language data question to the best matching endpoint of this service (official statistics, central bank rates, FX, energy, weather, holidays, research metadata) or catalog entry (World Bank indicators, Eurostat datasets, Statistics Canada and Destatis GENESIS tables), runs it and returns compact JSON with source, license and data_freshness. Also returns confidence and, when unsure, ready alternative calls. Examples: "convert 250 usd to eur", "weather berlin tomorrow", "germany inflation", "hospital beds germany eurostat". When to use: the first call for any data question when you do not know the endpoint id. For a task with several figures or countries pass questions, not one call each. Use call_api instead when you already have an id from an earlier answer, get_series for a long numeric history. If nothing matches it returns status "unfulfilled"; search_apis lists endpoints by keyword. Read-only, no API key or signup. Free quota: 1000 calls/day per IP, shared across tools.

questions.description: Several questions answered in one call, in place of query. Split a task into one question per figure and place, e.g. ["inflation chile", "inflation peru"]. Each counts as one call of the quota.

name: ask_anything
title: Answer a data question
